lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spatial distribution follows a grid-like pattern with approximately 4-5 spots visible per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity bands intersect with the circular centroids, creating anchor nodes where the luminance is highest. These intersections are most pronounced in the mid-flank area where vertical lines transition into discrete spots.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light pixels above to shadowed pixels below, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique vermiculated or wavy high-luminance line patterns are present in the transitional zone immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, preceding the more regular grid pattern.
